_doc: Presentation around the runs (src/client/present.ts, view only). intro: a Tour level's flyover, seconds long, before its clock runs (any key or pad button skips it): from high over its S-K-A-T-E letters (spreadHeight x their spread up, between minHeight and maxHeight m; swing: how far it curves sideways, a fraction of the spread), down toward the start, round behind the skater (behind m back, behindHeight m up), onto the chase camera; field of view from fovFrom to the chase camera's; every sample of the path kept clear m over what is below it and ceiling m under anything above it (the freeway over the park), samples along it; each sample rises riseStep m at a time (riseTries at most) until nothing is between it and what it looks at and no wall is within wall m beside it. levels: a level's own numbers (any of the intro's), ceilingZ (a height the camera never goes over: the park's freeway deck is drawn but not solid) and own key poses ([[pos], [look]] in order; the chase camera is added at the end). replay: the best combo of a timed run, looped behind the results card at speed (0.5 = half speed), from lead ticks before its pop to tail ticks after it banks (at most maxSeconds of it), pause seconds between loops; combos under minPoints are not worth a replay; the replay camera aims shift x its distance to the left so the skater sits right of the card.
